selected.title: Anthropic bans 'sustained and needless' cruelty toward Claude
verified_facts: Anthropic updated its Usage Policy (announced Oct 8, 2026), effective Nov 12, 2026 (MacRumors, PCWorld, Notebookcheck, Inc42)
New rule bars 'sustained and needless abusive or cruel behavior' toward Claude (MacRumors, Android Authority, Interesting Engineering)
Ordinary frustration/venting, pushback, dark creative themes and model testing/research are not covered (PCWorld, Android Authority, Gizmodo)
Primary enforcement: Claude ending the conversation; no new messages in that chat, new chat can be started (Android Authority, Notebookcheck)
Anthropic did not specify account bans (Android Authority, Gizmodo)
Claude models could already end persistently abusive conversations since August 2025 (Yahoo/TechCrunch, Gizmodo)
Applies to all Claude users including free plan (Android Authority, MacRumors)
Same update tightens rules on election interference, weapons and surveillance (Inc42, Gizmodo/aiweekly)
